elaine_pm: Proposal: islanded rollout for tenant-sensitive routing (so pilot tenants isolated from global ramp). Need clear aborts + per-tenant opt-out.
raj_eng: Plan: shadow -> islanded pilots (3 tenants) -> sequential tenant ramps -> regional ramp -> global. Manual gate before global.
sam_sre: Abort triggers: tenant_divergence >0.1% for 15m, p99 latency +80ms for 5m, error_rate spike >0.4% for 5m, billing delta >6% per tenant -> pause. Also watch cache_miss +10% for 20m.
ivy_platform: Flag model: `islanded_route_v1` with fields: `pilot_tenants`, `tenant_pct`, `global_pct`, `tenant_override_api`, `audit_log_url`. Will expose per-tenant force-off.
raj_eng: A/B inside island: 70% control / 30% candidate. Run divergence checker after 10k requests per tenant. If divergence >0.05% pause that tenant.
elaine_pm: Comm: notify pilot tenants 48h prior; CS to have opt-out script. If auto-rollback happens inform customers: "routing reverted while we investigate".
flag-bot: Draft flag created: islanded_route_v1 by ivy_platform. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/islanded-route (request perms).
sam_sre: Oncall: I'll own first 48h and prepare kill-switch. Pager on abort triggers. Slack-only for non-critical variance.
raj_eng: Test plan: unit + e2e, 3h shadow with synthetic tenant traffic, idempotency and cache-affinity probes.
elaine_pm: Schedule: shadow tonight 22:30 UTC, pilots tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Owners: elaine_pm (PM), raj_eng (eng lead), sam_sre (SRE), ivy_platform (flags). PM signoff required at manual gate.
elaine_pm: closing thread unless objections. Thanks!
